description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of stimulus types used in a study, as indicated by the central label “Stimulus Type.” The chart contains eight slices representing different categories. Starting from the largest and proceeding clockwise, the slices are labeled “Draft/Other” in red, accounting for 26.4% of the total; “Press Release” in orange, representing 18.7%; “External News Article” in teal, at 18.1%; “Intra-agency news article” in dark blue, at 4.9%; “Interview” in navy blue, at 8.8%; “Organizational Website” in light blue, at 4.9%; “Event Posting” in purple, at 6.6%; and “Email” in green, representing 2.7%. Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice. A legend is not present, but the chart does include labels for each slice directly adjacent to the pie. The slices appear to be ordered visually by decreasing proportion, with the largest slice positioned at the top and decreasing as they proceed clockwise.
